optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Logistics Delivery Services
professionalSummary: Seasoned finance operations professional with two years of ownership over weekly partner settlement runs for a large parcel carrier division, managing payment releases within a delegated authority of 400,000 and coordinating with divisional finance for higher amounts.
Expertise in maintaining settlement rules and partner rate tables in the settlement tool, ensuring accurate and auditable rate changes.
Proven leader of weekly settlement reviews with partner management, documenting decisions and resolving disputes with clear ownership boundaries.
experienceHighlights: Owned weekly partner settlement run, releasing payment files to accounts payable under a 400,000 delegated limit, with co-release for higher amounts.
Maintained settlement rules and partner rate tables, logging each rate change with contract reference and effective date.
Led weekly settlement review with partner management, deciding on disputed items and recording decisions in the review log.
Coordinated partner disputes with partner management and accounts payable, clearly delineating responsibility boundaries.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Release log showing payment files released under candidate's user ID with amounts and run identifiers; review log for one month, demonstrating verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume excerpts and work sample logs establish the candidate’s ownership of the weekly settlement run, release authority, rule maintenance, review leadership, dispute coordination, and documentation practices. They do not provide evidence of handling 1,100 partners, daily interaction with partner management and accounts payable, or accountability to a divisional finance manager beyond the two-year period.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on available evidence; further verification of scale and daily interactions is recommended.

role.roleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Logistics Delivery Services

evidence.text: Owned the weekly partner settlement run for the delivery division for two years, releasing the payment file to accounts payable under my delegated release authority of 400,000 per run, with runs above the limit co-released by the divisional finance manager.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of ownership and authority

evidence.text: Reference call with the former divisional finance manager: confirmed the candidate owned the settlement run, held the 400,000 release limit and led the weekly review; confirmed employment dates.
Maintained the settlement rules and the partner rate tables in the settlement tool, logging every rate change with the contract reference and the effective date.
Led the weekly settlement review with partner management, deciding which disputed items were held back and recording the decisions in the review log.
Coordinated partner disputes with partner management and accounts payable, recording that partner management owned the relationship conversation while I owned the settlement decision.
Responsibilities included settlement-run ownership, payment-file release within limit, rule maintenance and the settlement review for the delivery division over about two years.
